class.name: SoundFontLoader
class.brief_description: A resource format loader for SoundFont 2 files.
class.description:
SoundFontLoader enables Godot's resource loading system to load SoundFont resources from SoundFont 2 (.sf2) files.
The loader recognizes files with the .sf2 extension, regardless of the extension's letter case, and identifies their resource type as SoundFont. Other file formats, including SoundFont 3 (.sf3), are not currently supported.
When loading a file, the loader creates a SoundFont resource and scans the specified file to initialize it. If scanning fails, an error is reported and an empty Variant is returned.
This class extends ResourceFormatLoader and is intended to be registered with Godot's resource loading system so that compatible files can be loaded through ResourceLoader.

method.name: _get_recognized_extensions
method.description: Returns the list of file extensions recognized by this loader. Currently, the list contains only "sf2".

method.name: _handles_type
method.description: Returns true if the requested resource type is "SoundFont"; otherwise, returns false.

method.name: _get_resource_type
method.description: Returns "SoundFont" if the file path has the .sf2 extension, ignoring case. Returns an empty string for unsupported extensions.

method.name: _load
method.description:
Creates a SoundFont resource and scans the file specified by path to load its contents.
Returns the initialized SoundFont resource if scanning succeeds. If scanning fails, reports an error containing the file path and returns an empty Variant.
The original_path, use_sub_threads, and cache_mode parameters are provided to satisfy the ResourceFormatLoader interface but are not used by this implementation.
